title: Kiwi
description:
Built Kiwi's decentralized inference engine, which splits an LLM across a swarm of small machines and streams activations between them peer-to-peer over libp2p.
Handles machines joining and dropping out with VRAM-aware layer assignment, heartbeat-based eviction, rerouting and paged KV cache management.
Built decentralized LoRA fine-tuning on top of it as part of the team: 43% faster on 7 workers with instant recovery when a worker drops. Published at the NeurIPS 2026 CODEC-FM workshop.

title: NAAMSE
description:
Built the core of an evolutionary AI red-teaming framework that uses genetic algorithms to mutate prompt-injection attacks.
2nd place out of 1,500+ submissions at Berkeley RDI's AgentX competition. Later forked by Mozilla's 0din team.

title: HASHIRU
description:
Built a budget-aware multi-agent framework where a 'CEO' agent manages specialized 'employee' agents.
Keeps compute, inference cost and token usage within budget across parallel agents.

title: gem5 Vision
description:
Built search and categorization for the gem5 Resources site, making simulator resources easier to find.
Added support for multiple database backends for storing and serving resources.

title: QuixFolio
description:
Open-source portfolio builder that deploys your portfolio to GitHub Pages in minutes.
1,000+ page views in the first week of the alpha.

title: Stadia Wireless
description:
Made the Google Stadia controller work wirelessly on any device using WebSockets.
450+ GitHub stars, covered by The Verge and Ars Technica.

title: VeggieBuddie
description:
App that scans ingredient labels to tell you if a product fits your diet.
Most Social Good Hack at HackDavis and a Top 20 Google Solution Challenge pick.
